extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question: (1) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g. '3,550'); fixed by casting to numeric. (2) Two rows had impossible body mass values (3,800,000 and 5,950,000 g); excluded. (3) One row had an impossible flipper length (-228 mm); excluded. (4) Two rows were exact duplicates; removed. (5) 'island' had leading/trailing spaces; normalized to match allowed values. (6) 'sex' had 2 missing values; left as missing (per rules). After fixes, the average body mass for females is 3718.33 g and for males is 4375.89 g.
